montage-login-description: You will be redirected to Meta-Wiki in order to confirm your identity. Montage will not publish anything on Wikimedia projects using your account.
montage-login-account-instructions: If you don't have a Wikimedia account, you can create one on {0}.
montage-manage-all: View all campaigns, active and archived below
montage-view-active: view only active campaigns and rounds.
montage-description-campaign-url: Enter URL of campaign landing page, e.g., on Commons or local Wiki Loves.
montage-description-date-range: Once the images are imported to the first round, changing date and time won't affect the images your jury can view. However, changing these values before the import to round 1 will ensure that only photos uploaded before the end date and time are visible to your jury.
montage-description-campaign-coordinator: Coordinators are people who have access to edit the campaign, rounds, and round statistics.
montage-required-campaign-coordinators: At least one coordinator is required
montage-description-round-stats: Whether to show own voting statistics (e.g. number of accepted or declined images) of juror for the round.
montage-description-round-quorum: The number of jurors that must vote on each image
montage-description-round-jurors: Enter the username of the juror you want to add to this round.
montage-round-stats-description: Whether to show own voting statistics (e.g., number of accepted or declined images) of juror for the round.
montage-round-delete-confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this round?
montage-round-min-resolution-help: Minimum image resolution in pixels. Images below this resolution will be automatically disqualified. Default is 2,000,000 pixels (2 megapixels).
montage-round-source-category-help: Category on Wikimedia Commons that gathers all contest images. Example: Images from Wiki Loves Monuments 2026 in Ghana.
montage-round-source-csv-help: Link to a Google Sheet (anyone with the link can view), a gist or a CSV file. Columns: filename, and optionally file_id (the number Commons gives the file itself, not its page ID).
montage-round-source-selected-help: One file name or file ID per line; you can mix them, and the File: prefix is optional. A file ID is the number Commons gives the file itself (the file_id column of a check download), not the page ID shown under Page information. You can also paste a CSV with the columns filename and/or file_id, such as the download after a check.
montage-round-file-url: Link to the sheet or file list
montage-round-file-list: File names or file IDs (one per line)
montage-round-jurors-description: Enter the username of the juror you want to add to this round.
montage-round-quorum-description: The number of jurors that must vote on each image
montage-vote-contact-organizer: This round is not active. Please contact the organizer.
montage-vote-keyboard-instructions: You can also use the keyboard to vote.
montage-vote-no-images: You voted on all images in this round. You can still edit your previous votes using the button below.
montage-vote-no-images-warning: WARNING - there is a chance that your browser is still loading the next tasks. Please check the main page of Montage to verify if 'your progress' is indeed 100%.
montage-no-votes-this-round: You haven't voted on any image this round.
montage-at-least-one-user: Please add at least one user
permission-denied-message: You do not have the required permissions to access this page.
montage-required-threshold: Please select a threshold before continuing
unsaved-changes-confirmation: There are unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to leave?
montage-round-check-required: Check the source before saving the round.
montage-round-check-summary: Rows checked: {0}. Files that can be imported: {1}.
montage-round-check-blocking: Some rows block the import (marked below). Fix them in the source, then check the source again.
montage-round-check-truncated: Showing the first {0} of {1} rows with problems. Download all of them below.
montage-round-check-download: Download the files that can be imported (CSV)
montage-round-check-download-partial: Download only the files without problems (CSV)
montage-round-check-expired: Nothing was saved: a check is valid for one hour, because files change on Commons. Check the source again, then save. Your other settings are kept.
montage-round-check-status-page-id: Page ID, not a file ID
montage-round-check-status-revision-id: Revision ID, not a file ID
montage-round-check-status-same-name: Same name as another file inside this import
montage-round-check-same-name-title: Different files with names Montage cannot tell apart
montage-round-check-same-name-list: These names differ only in capital letters, accents or similar letters (such as е and ё). Remove rows until one file of each group is left, then check the source again.
montage-round-check-same-name-category: These names differ only in capital letters, accents or similar letters (such as е and ё). Only the first file of each group is imported; the others are left out.
montage-round-check-nothing-to-import: None of the files in the source can be imported. Fix the source, then check the source again.
montage-round-check-failed-short: The source could not be checked.
montage-round-check-summary-category: Files in the category: {0}. Files that can be imported: {1}.
montage-round-check-cleared: The source changed. Check the source again.
montage-round-category-pick: Pick a category from the suggestions.
montage-round-saving-with-files: Saving the round and importing the files…
montage-round-save-blocked-recheck: The import was refused: the source has rows that block it. Check the source again to see them.
montage-round-reload-page: Montage has been updated. Reload the page, then check the source again.
montage-round-not-saved: The round was not saved, and no files were imported. You can try again.
montage-round-save-unknown: The connection was interrupted while saving. The round may have been created: look at the campaign page before you save again.
montage-round-check-download-partial-hel: To import only these files: choose File List, paste the content of the downloaded file into the box, then check the source again.
montage-round-check-warnings-only: You can save the round. Some rows are left out or changed; they are listed below.
montage-round-save-hint-unchecked: You can save once the source has been checked.
montage-round-save-hint-blocked: You cannot save yet: some rows block the import. See the check result above.
montage-round-save-hint-empty: You cannot save: none of the files can be imported. See the check result above.
montage-round-check-reason-renamed: Renamed on Commons: {0} is now {1}. It is imported under the new name.
montage-round-check-reason-duplicate: The same file as row {0}; it is imported once.
montage-round-check-reason-unknown-name: {0} was not found on Commons. Check the spelling; the file may have been renamed or deleted. This row is left out.
montage-round-check-reason-unknown-file-: No file on Commons has file ID {0}. A file ID is not the page ID shown under Page information. Check the number, or write the file name instead.
montage-round-check-reason-malformed-fil: "{0}" is not a file ID. A file ID is a whole number such as 149673020, without dots, commas or E+.
montage-round-check-reason-page-id: {0} is the page ID of File:{1}, not its file ID. Montage needs the file ID or the file name: write the file name instead: {1}
montage-round-check-reason-revision-id: {0} is a revision ID (one edit of the page File:{1}), not a file ID. Montage needs the file ID or the file name: write the file name instead: {1}
montage-round-check-reason-same-name: Montage cannot tell this name apart from {0}.
montage-round-check-reason-same-name-cat: Left out: Montage cannot tell this name apart from {0}, which is imported.
montage-round-check-error-csv-unreadable: The file could not be read as CSV. Check that it is a plain CSV file.
montage-round-check-error-too-many-rows: The source has {0} rows; at most {1} can be imported at once.
montage-round-check-error-no-file-names: Enter at least one file name or file ID.
montage-round-check-error-sheet-link-inv: This is not a valid Google Sheet link. Copy the link from the Share button of the sheet.
montage-round-check-error-https-only: Only https:// links can be imported: {0}
montage-round-check-error-cannot-load: The link could not be opened: {0}. Check that it is correct and public.
montage-round-check-error-not-public: The link does not point to a public website: {0}
montage-round-check-error-too-large: The file at {0} is larger than {1} MB.
montage-round-check-error-sheet-not-shar: The Google Sheet could not be read: {0}. Set its sharing to "Anyone with the link can view".
montage-round-check-error-not-utf8: The file at {0} is not UTF-8 text. Save it as UTF-8 and try again.
montage-round-check-error-no-name-column: The first row must name the columns: filename and/or file_id.
montage-round-import-saved: The round was saved with {0} files.
montage-round-import-left-out: These rows were left out or changed:
montage-round-import-all-disqualified: All files were disqualified by the round settings.
montage-round-check-status-same-name-exi: Same name as a file already in Montage
montage-round-check-reason-same-name-exi: Montage already has a different file named {0} and cannot tell the two names apart. Remove this row from the source.
Left out: Montage already has a different file named {0} and cannot tell the two names apart.
